items.source_en:
Hi Trent,

This is Ayesha, your Arc Might liason for this star system. We met last week during BioTech's Worker Welfare Inspection. I'm delighted to say that you passed with flying colors! 55 days with no injuries is extremely impressive, given the tight deadline on your project and the long hours your workers have been putting in.

Your team's stellar performance has earned you one of Arc Might's merit-based Onsite Bonus Packages! We've filled it with a suite of items that we think will make your team's experience even better. 

Congrats again! We don't get to give these out to foremen very often.

Ayesha

Don't get comfy. Security's been poking around the Stretch with a Rebel Deputy. Your target must've had friends in high places. They haven't found any witnesses yet, but you never know who's going to squeal.

items.source_en:
There have been growing concerns regarding Shadow Collective presence in the area. I hope this message will allay your fears. 

Yes, it's true that some Shadow Collective have been spotted in our system. This is not cause for concern, however. Although it may seem like they are approaching our location, this is impossible. 

You have all been assured that this facility and your work is top secret. This is still the case and will not change. Even if the Shadow Collective land on the planet, our location is still entirely secret. I assure you that you will all remain perfectly safe. 

In the event of an emergency, you will all be notified as soon as possible of evacuation procedures. However, I do not anticipate ever having to take such measures. 

Please continue your research as normal. If you have any further concerns, please speak with me directly. 

Thank you,

Chief Scientist Feldman
items.legacy_ko:
최근 우리 구역 내 섀도우 콜렉티브의 출현과 관련하여 우려의 목소리가 커지고 있습니다. 이 메시지가 여러분의 불안을 해소하는 데 도움이 되길 바랍니다.

네, 우리 성계에서 섀도우 콜렉티브가 목격된 것은 사실입니다. 하지만 걱정할 일은 아닙니다. 그들이 우리 위치로 접근하는 것처럼 보일지라도, 그것은 불가능한 일입니다.

여러분 모두 이 시설과 연구가 일급 기밀이라는 점을 보장받았습니다. 지금도 그렇고, 앞으로도 변함없을 것입니다. 설령 섀도우 콜렉티브가 행성에 착륙한다 하더라도, 우리의 위치는 여전히 완벽하게 비밀로 유지됩니다. 여러분 모두 안전할 것임을 약속드립니다.

비상 상황 발생 시, 즉시 대피 절차를 공지할 예정입니다. 하지만 그러한 조치를 취해야 할 상황은 오지 않으리라 예상합니다.

연구를 평소대로 계속해 주십시오. 추가적인 우려 사항이 있다면 직접 저를 찾아와 주시기 바랍니다.

감사합니다.

수석 과학자 펠드먼

items.source_en:
To: All Rebels
From: Emma Wilcox
Subject: Another false alarm

Just so you all know, that report we got about the farm on Mobetta turned out to be another false alarm. Local security says they headed out to take a look, and the man they talked to said nothing was wrong. Funny thing is, the original call came in from a woman and when security asked to talk to her, the man who they'd met said she went off-world to visit family. 

Normally I wouldn't think twice about it, but I'd read a similar report only a month earlier, where the call had come in from an elderly man, only local security didn't see anyone that old, and when they asked they were told he'd gone on a vacation.

Could be nothing, I know, but if anyone hears about trouble on a farm, let me know. Couldn't hurt to check it out.
items.legacy_ko:
수신: 모든 반란군
발신: 엠마 윌콕스
제목: 또 오보였음

다들 알아두라고 하는 말인데, 모베타 농장에 대한 보고는 또 오보로 밝혀졌습니다. 지역 보안팀이 확인하러 갔는데, 만난 남자가 아무 일도 없었다고 하더군요. 웃긴 건 최초 신고는 여자가 했는데, 보안팀이 그 여자와 대화하고 싶다고 하니 그 남자가 가족을 방문하러 행성 밖으로 나갔다고 했다는 겁니다.

평소라면 그냥 넘겼겠지만, 한 달 전에도 비슷한 보고를 읽은 적이 있거든요. 그때는 노인이 신고했는데 지역 보안팀은 그렇게 나이 든 사람을 본 적이 없고, 물어보니 휴가를 떠났다고 했다더군요.

별일 아닐 수도 있지만, 농장에서 문제가 생겼다는 소식을 들으면 알려주세요. 확인해서 나쁠 건 없으니까요.
